info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Baggages-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Baggage Inquiry API enables users to access information about baggage associated with airline flights. It provides detailed insights into baggage status, locations, and specifics for each flight, facilitating better passenger awareness and service. This API is primarily geared towards airline staff, travel agencies, and customer support teams seeking to enhance their service offerings by providing real-time baggage information. Frequent travelers and customers can also utilize this API for tracking and inquiring about their luggage.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed baggage information associated with flights, including dimensions, weight limits, and any additional fees that may apply.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information related to flights. This JSON object must include the necessary parameters to specify the query for baggage details.

ListAirlineFlightsBaggagesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to baggage information in the flights API. It is expected to be a string formatted in JSON.
